thread:
marta: Starting a short thread to finalize the release notes for Thursday docs deploy. Focus: embedding deprecation blurb, Dedicated autoscale billing note, fallback routing example, Private migration checklist, and a link-redirect sweep. Need owners for snippets and a tiny known-issues section.

kevin: I can take JS/TS snippets. Which streaming pages need conversion to polling?

marta: All JS quickstarts that call streaming directly. Convert to polling with a short note about latency tradeoffs. Keep examples minimal.

jia: I'll pick Go auth + Python embed. For Python embed, include legacy call with a one-line deprecation banner plus the new batch example and a link to migration steps.

sam: I'll draft the fallback routing example and the Private migration checklist scaffold (canary deploy steps, smoke tests, rollback). Config draft: {"policy":"latency_preferred","fallback":["kestrel-xl","kestrel-l"]}. Snippet will show try->fallback->UX toast.

kevin: For JS, I'll include checking resp.meta.model so QA can see which model served the request and a short polling loop example with exponential backoff.

oliver: Product asks for this billing line for Dedicated autoscale: "Autoscale pools can now be configured with burst buckets; burst consumption is billed at the burst rate." I'll get finance to confirm exact phrasing.

zara: Infra note: small Dedicated cohort saw p95 warm-start regression overnight. Status: investigating. Add a conservative Known issues bullet pointing to the incident channel.

release-bot: Draft relnotes page created: /docs/releases/2026-03-26-relnotes-sprint. PR #4922.

marta: Owners summary: JS/TS -> kevin; Go/Python -> jia; fallback + migration scaffold -> sam; relnotes blurb + finance -> oliver/zara; link sweep -> kevin. Please add :eyes: on PRs when done.

kevin: ETA: I'll open JS PR by EOD PST and include anchor-check GH action.

jia: I'll have Go/Python up tomorrow AM.

sam: Migration scaffold going up today. I'll include smoke test commands and expected JSON keys for QA.

marta: Great. I'll assemble the final relnotes and ping reviewers. Thanks all. :pray:
